extraction.document_summary: Great Eastern’s “PayAssure” is a stand-alone disability income insurance plan that pays a monthly benefit during the benefit period if you are not engaged in any gainful occupation due to disability. After the chosen pre-beneﬁt period of 60, 90, or 180 days, you receive monthly benefits for as long as you continue to suffer from disability, up to age 55, 60, or 65 (depending on the plan option) or your death. Premiums due while you are receiving the monthly benefit are waived, but premiums falling due during the pre-beneﬁt period must be paid in full. If your present earnings are 85% or less of pre-disability earnings, partial monthly benefits may apply. The plan can also reimburse rehabilitation expenses (certified as necessary) up to three times the selected monthly benefit, and provides a death benefit of six times the selected monthly benefit.

policies.quick_summary: Stand-alone disability income plan paying monthly benefits after a pre-beneﬁt period, with premium waiver during benefit payment, possible partial monthly benefits based on earnings, rehabilitation expense reimbursement, and a death benefit of six times the selected monthly benefit (as stated in the brochure). Evidence-based mechanics are stated; full eligibility and exclusions are not fully provided in the supplied text extract. Ages refer to next birthday and the pre-beneﬁt options include 60/90/180 days; benefit duration ends at a specified age or death (age 55/60/65). The brochure also states premiums are not guaranteed and may be adjusted.
